moment: The ending at the high-altitude Ladakh lake (Pangong-style): yellow scooter parked on the pebble shore at sunrise
why: Yellow scooter on a stony shore of a glassy blue Himalayan lake is the signature final shot of 3 Idiots. A drawn circle and tick ring the scooter, like a 'found it' marker.

moment: Hogwarts Great Hall at night: floating candles over the four long house tables, staff table on the dais
why: Hundreds of hovering candles, gothic windows, four long tables with gold plates and goblets: unmistakably the Great Hall.

moment: Campus courtyard: a home-built camera quadcopter hovering beside stone-and-concrete corridors (the drone scene)
why: Exposed stone/concrete colonnades and lawns look like the Indian engineering campus in 3 Idiots, and a DIY camera drone is a key prop there. Without the film context it would read as just 'a drone on a campus'.

moment: Same campus courtyard, drone hovering over the lawn between pergola corridors and brick blocks
why: Same reading as J037: brutalist Indian campus and a hand-built quadcopter with camera.

moment: Blood-red sunset over a ranch homestead, lone oak and split-rail fence; X target marks in the sky like Dead Eye tags
why: Red-graded western ranch, mountains, wooden fence and the X 'tag' marks strongly evoke RDR2's Dead Eye targeting and its red-sky look.

moment: The Marauder's Map: folded parchment with corridors and walking inked footprints, ribbon label
why: Aged fold-creased parchment, corridor outlines, and animated footprint trails are exactly the Marauder's Map look.

moment: Ghost ship with tattered black sails in a moonlit storm (Black Pearl / Flying Dutchman); gold dotted trail ending in an X
why: Ragged black sails, lantern-lit stern windows, fog and a treasure-map dotted path with X: classic Pirates of the Caribbean imagery.

moment: Red-sky ranch with crows, a line strung through four X targets: a Dead Eye shot sequence
why: Same ranch plate as J035 with an aim path linking X marks, which reads as RDR2 Dead Eye 'paint targets then fire'.

moment: Hogwarts Great Hall, floating candles, empty tables at night
why: Same Great Hall plate as J038, slightly different framing.

moment: Ghost ship under a full moon with Jack Sparrow's compass drawn in gold
why: Tattered-sail galleon plus an octagonal hinged compass (Jack Sparrow's compass that doesn't point north).

moment: Storm at sea with a teal-lit breaking wave; below it a treasure-map route from compass past a skull to an X
why: The photo alone is a generic stormy sea; the compass, skull and X-marks-the-spot route make it piratical.

moment: Empty stone lecture hall, sunlit colonnade, chalk drawing of a quadcopter on the blackboard
why: Stone-walled Indian college classroom with wooden benches and a drone on the board evokes the 3 Idiots classrooms; could also be a generic classroom.

moment: Marauder's Map header: parchment with ribbon banner, corner seals and footprints walking across
why: Same Marauder's Map treatment: footprints, crease folds, ornamental corner roundels.

moment: Yellow scooter at the Ladakh lake shore; a row of small drawn boxes with one circled above it
why: Same Pangong-style lake + yellow scooter as J039; the circled box above reads as a selection/'this one' mark.

moment: Night sea with a bioluminescent breaking wave, distant ship on the horizon, gold compass
why: Dark ocean, lone square-rigger on the horizon and Jack's compass. The sea alone could be anything.

moment: Van der Linde gang camp at dusk: canvas tents, covered wagon, cookpot over campfire, lake and peaks
why: The tent-and-wagon lakeside camp with lanterns looks very like RDR2's Horseshoe Overlook camp.

moment: Chalkboard in a sunlit stone room with a drone sketch and a bar chart, one bar highlighted
why: Drone on a chalkboard suggests 3 Idiots, but the gothic arched sandstone window pulls toward Hogwarts. Mixed signals, low confidence.

moment: Arthur Morgan's journal: pencil sketches of pines, a lake, a saddled horse, taped note on cream paper
why: Graphite sketchbook spread with horse, pines and a taped note is the RDR2 journal style.

moment: Enchanted ceiling of the Great Hall: floating candles against a starry night sky
why: Candles suspended in a star field is the Great Hall ceiling; no other world uses that motif.

moment: Sunset ocean with a ship on the horizon and a glowing wake; treasure-map route below
why: Ship-on-horizon plus compass/skull/X map reads piratical; the sunset sea itself is generic.

moment: Hogwarts castle across the Black Lake at night with floating candles and a broomstick
why: Castle silhouette on the cliff, lake reflections, broomstick and floating candles: explicitly Hogwarts.

moment: Night sea, glowing wave, distant ship; compass riding the wave
why: Same as J025; compass is the main pirate cue.

moment: Parchment on a candlelit floor with ink veins spreading from the centre and footprints (map revealing itself / Riddle-diary ink)
why: Floating candles, castle through the windows and footprints on parchment place it at Hogwarts; the spreading ink reads like the map or diary revealing writing.

moment: Night camp: two canvas tents and a campfire under dark mountains
why: Fits the RDR2 camp mood but the image alone is a generic campsite.

moment: Virus's astronaut pen in a velvet case with a stopwatch on a classroom desk
why: An engraved 'astronaut' pen in a presentation box next to a stopwatch is the 3 Idiots director's prized pen (and his obsession with time).

moment: Same astronaut pen and stopwatch on the desk, slightly different framing
why: Same reading as J015.

moment: Darkened ghost ship with Jack's compass and a dotted course line running down
why: Ghost-ship silhouette and the octagonal compass; image is very dark, so cues are faint.

moment: Ghost ship behind a gold-ruled treasure chart: dotted course from X, an island outline, compass rose
why: Treasure chart with X and island over the ghost ship is piratical; scene is dim.

moment: Stone lecture hall with chalk quadcopter sketch, gear and a flight-path curve on the board
why: Same classroom as J028; stone Indian campus + drone sketch.

moment: Wanted/bounty posters pinned to a weathered wooden board, one blank poster pulled forward
why: Western wanted-poster board fits RDR2 (bounty boards), but could be any western.

moment: Hogwarts Express crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct in the Highlands
why: Red steam locomotive and carriages on the curved stone viaduct over a loch is the iconic Hogwarts Express shot.

moment: Golden-hour valley with a winding river and a lone grazing horse under a big oak
why: Painterly American frontier landscape with a horse; strongly RDR2-like, but no unique landmark.

moment: Floating candles drifting in a starry night background, thin rule lines between rows
why: Floating candles motif; mostly background texture.

moment: Floating candles in a night sky, one candle framed by teal targeting brackets (a candle 'catch' game)
why: The candles say Great Hall; the bracket reticle is UI, not film.

moment: Golden valley sunset with grazing horse, full-bleed
why: Same plate as J008, bigger.

moment: Journal spread: crossed-out grid sketch, lake, pines, saddled horse, red pencil underline
why: Same Arthur Morgan sketchbook style as J022.

moment: Moonlit harbour with tall ships at a lantern-lit quay (Port Royal / Tortuga) and a treasure-map route
why: Colonial-era harbour at night with masted ships, plus compass-skull-X route.

moment: Wanted posters on a frontier town notice board, dusty street behind
why: Same bounty-board scene as J010 with a western street visible.

moment: Gang camp at sunset: hitched horses, covered wagon, campfire with cookpot, tents above a lake
why: Horses at a hitching rail, wagon, canvas tents and lake view: very close to RDR2's Horseshoe Overlook camp.
